upheld.title: Duplicated 'not saved for later' error message
upheld.detail: MoveToCart writes the not-found message inline, and ThrowSavedItemNotFound builds the same text again for its one caller, RemoveSavedItem. If one copy is edited, the two calls will report the same error differently.
upheld.requirement: Pr-check style item 2: no duplicated logic; the existing BasketService keeps each error in one [DoesNotReturn] helper (ThrowNotAuthenticated, ThrowBasketDoesNotExist).

upheld.title: Unneeded `using System.Linq;` in the new unit test
upheld.detail: Implicit usings are on for every project (Directory.Build.props:9), so the explicit `using System.Linq;` does nothing. The neighbouring BasketServiceTests.cs does not have it.
upheld.requirement: Match the file's neighbors (Project context: 'match the file you are in'); tests/Basket.UnitTests/BasketServiceTests.cs:1-10 and Directory.Build.props:9 ImplicitUsings.

upheld.title: No video shows AC4 quantity merge or AC6 sign-out/sign-in persistence
upheld.detail: Video 03 moves Cedar Headlamp (qty 3) into a cart that did not already contain it, so the quantity-add rule is never shown on screen; no video signs the shopper out and back in. Every other user-visible criterion is recorded.
